title: EMPLOYMENT AGREEMENT
description: Click on clauses you think contain legal or fairness risks.

clauses.text: Party A: Shanghai Yuanjing Information Technology Co., Ltd.
Position: Data Analyst, Work location: Shanghai
Monthly salary: 20,000 RMB, paid on the 10th day of each month
The employer may adjust the employee’s position at any time without consent.
Overtime work is required but will not be compensated.
clauses.hint: Unpaid overtime is illegal in many jurisdictions.

clauses.text: The employee must not resign within the first 2 years.
Liquidated damages are set at three times the monthly salary.
All disputes shall be decided solely by the employer.
The employee must follow company policies and regulations.
This contract becomes effective upon signature by both parties.
